countermodel: Split extension L=Z⊕C2 with p(a,b)=b: no element above z doubles to a kernel generator.

deletion_audit.add_generator_orientation: UNNECESSARY; quotient by inversion already yields canonical classes.

half_object.semantic_type: orientation-free quotient-valued bridge object, not a scalar

maps.theorem: Well-defined and bijective. Inversion x->-x sends 2x->-2x, the same R5 class.
Well-defined because p(x)=p(-x)=z; its action image is the frozen S4 negation action.

relation_to_R2: Under the already-frozen S4/A* realization, R3=R2 in Sym(ODir). No new equality axiom is used.

theorem.statement: In S6+BEX3, Half(p) is a canonical singleton inversion class; doubling identifies it canonically with R5, while projection followed by the frozen G2 action realizes R3 (hence R2 under the frozen direction-coherence theorem).
